text.body:
<1> pātrāṇi sūtradhāraḥ naṭī vijayā --- pratihārī | pāripārśvikaḥ| rāmaḥ --- daśarathasya jyeṣṭhaḥ putraḥ| lakṣmaṇaḥ --- rāmānujaḥ sugrīvaḥ --- kapīśvaraḥ| hanūmān --- vānaramukhyaḥ| vālī --- kiṣkindhādhipatiḥ| tārā --- bālipatnī| aṅgadaḥ --- bāliputraḥ kakubhaḥ --- kapīśvarasya bhṛtyaḥ | vilamukhaḥ --- sugrīvasya vārtāharaḥ| sītā --- rāmapatnī| rāvaṇaḥ --- laṅkeśvaraḥ vibhīṣaṇaḥ --- laṅkeśvarasya bhrātā| vānara kāñcukīyaḥ --- balādhyakṣaḥ --- varuṇaḥ --- nīlaḥ --- vānarasenādhyakṣaḥ| śukasāraṇau --- māyārupadhāriṇau rākṣasau| rākṣasakāñcukīyaḥ rākṣasaḥ vidvijvihvaḥ --- māyāvī rākṣasaḥ| vidyādharāstrayaḥ agniḥ prathamoṅkaḥ (nāndyante tataḥ praviśati sūtradhāraḥ|) sūtradhāraḥ --- yo gādhiputramakhavighnakarābhihantā yuddhe virādhakharadūṣaṇavīryahantā | darpodyatolbaṇakabandhakapīndrahantā pāyāt sa vo niśicarendrakulābhihantā || 1 || evamāryamiśrān vijñāpayāmi| (parikramyāvalokya) aye kinnu khalu mayi vijñāpanavyagre śabda iva śrūyate! aṅga! paśyāmi| (nepathye) sugrīva! ita itaḥ| (praviśya) paripārśvikaḥ --- bhāva! kuto nu khalveṣa samutthito dhvaniḥ pravartate śrotravidāraṇo mahān | pracaṇḍavātoddhṛtabhīmagāmināṃ balāhakānāmiva khe'bhigarjatām || 2 || sūtradhāraḥ --- mārṣa! kiṃ nāvagacchasi| eṣa khalu sītāpaharaṇajanitasantāpasya raghukulapradīpasya sarvalokanayanābhirāmasya rāmasya ca, dārābhimarśananirviṣayīkṛtasya sarvaharyṛkṣarājasya suvipulamahāgrīvasya sugrīvasya ca parasparopakārakṛtapratijñayoḥ sarvavānarādhipatiṃ hemamālinaṃ vālinaṃ hantuṃ samudyogaḥ pravartate| tata eto hi, idānīṃ rājyavibhraṣṭaṃ sugrīvaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau | punaḥ sthāpayituṃ prāptāvindraṃ hariharāviva || 3 || (niṣkrāntau) sthāpanā | (tataḥ praviśati rāmo, lakṣmaṇasugrīvau, hanumāṃśca|) rāmaḥ --- sugrīva! ita itaḥ| matsāyakānnihatabhinnavikīrṇadehaṃ śatru tavādya sahasā bhuvi pātayāmi | rājan! bhayaṃ tyaja mamāpi samīpavartī dṛṣṭastvayā ca samare nihataḥ sa vālī || 4 || sugrīvaḥ --- deva! ahaṃ khalvāryasya prasādād devānāmapi rājyamāśaṅke kiṃ punarvānarāṇām| kutaḥ, mukto deva! tavādya vālihṛdayaṃ bhettuṃ na me saṃśayaḥ sālān sapta mahāvane himagireḥ śrṛṅgopamācchrīdhara ! | bhittvā vegavaśāt praviśya dharaṇīṃ gatvā ca nāgālayaṃ majjan vīra! payonidhau punarayaṃ samprāptavān sāyakaḥ || 5 || hanumān --- tava nṛpa! mukhaniḥsṛtairvacobhirvigatabhayā hi vayaṃ vinaṣṭaśokāḥ | raghuvara! haraye jayaṃ pradātuṃ girimabhigaccha sanīranīradābham || 6 || lakṣmaṇaḥ --- ārya! sopasnehatayā vanāntarasyābhitaḥ khalu kiṣkindhayā bhavitavyam| sugrīvaḥ --- samyagāha kumāraḥ| samprāptā harivarabāhusampraguptā kiṣkindhā tava nṛpa! bāhusampraguptā | tiṣṭha tvaṃ nṛvara! karomyahaṃ visaṃjñaṃ nādena pracalamahīdharaṃ nṛlokam || 7 || rāmaḥ --- bhavatu gaccha| sugrīvaḥ --- yadājñāpayati devaḥ| (parikramya) bhoḥ| aparādhamanuddiśya parityaktastvayā vibho !| yuddhe tvatpādaśuśrūṣāṃ sugrīvaḥ kartumicchati || 8 || (nepathye) kathaṃ kathaṃ sugrīva iti| (tataḥ praviśati bālī gṛhītavastrayā tārayā saha|) bālī --- kathaṃ kathaṃ sugrīva iti| tāre! vimuñca mama vastramaninditāṅgi ! prastrastavaktranayane! kimasi pravṛttā | sugrīvamadya samare vinipātyamānaṃ taṃ paśya śoṇitapariplutasarvagātram || 9 || tārā --- pasīau pasīau mahārāo| appeṇa kāraṇeṇa ṇa āgasmissai suggīo | tā amaccavaggeṇa saha sammantia gantavvaṃ| (prasīdatu prasidatu mahārājaḥ| alpena kāraṇena nāgamiṣyati sugrīvaḥ| tadamātyavargeṇa saha saṃmantrya gantavyam|) bālī --- āḥ, śakro vā bhavatu gatiḥ śaśāṅkavaktre ! śatrorme niśitaparaśvadhaḥ śivo vā | nālaṃ māmabhimukhametya samprahartuṃ viṣṇurvā vikasitapuṇḍarīkanetraḥ || 10 || tārā --- pasīau pasīau mahārao| imassa jaṇassa aṇuggāhaṃ dāva kareuṃ arihadi mahārāo| (prasīdatu prasīdatu mahārājaḥ| asya janasyānugrahaṃ tāvat kartumarhati mahārājaḥ|) bālī --- śrūyatāṃ matparākramaḥ| tāre! mayā khalu purāmṛtamanthane'pi gatvā prahasya suradānavadaityasaṅghān | utphullanetramuragendramudagrarūpamākṛṣyamāṇamavalokya suvismitāste || 11 ||9 tārā --- pasīau pasīau mahārāo| (prasīdatu prasīdatu mahārājaḥ|) bālī --- āḥ mama vaśānuvartinī bhava | praviśa tvamabhyantaram | tārā --- esā gacchāmi mandabhāā (niṣkrāntā) eṣā gacchāmi mandabhāgā | bālī --- hanta praviṣṭā tārā| yāvadahaṃ sugrīvaṃ bhagnagrīvaṃ karomi | (drutamupagamya) sugrīva! tiṣṭha tiṣṭha | indro vā śaraṇaṃ te'stu prabhurvā madhusūdanaḥ | maccakṣuṣpathamāsādya sajīvo naiva yāsyasi || 12 || ita itaḥ| sugrīvaḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| (ubhau niyuddhaṃ kurutaḥ|) rāmaḥ --- eṣa eṣa bālī, sandaṣṭoṣṭhaścaṇḍasaṃraktanetro muïṣṭa kṛtvā gāḍhamudvṛttadaṃṣṭraḥ | garjan bhīmaṃ vānaro bhāti yuddhe saṃvartagniḥ sandidhakṣuryathaiva || 13 || lakṣmaṇaḥ --- sugrīvamapi paśyatvāryaḥ, vikasitaśatapatraraktanetraḥ kanakamayāṅgadanaddhapīnabāhuḥ | harivaramupayāti vānaratvād gurumabhibhūya satāṃ vihāya vṛttam || 14 || vālinā tāḍitaḥ patitaḥ sugrīvaḥ| hanumān --- hā! dhik| (sasambhramaṃ rāmamupagamya) jayatu devaḥ| asyaiṣāvasthā| balavān vānarendrastu durbalaśca patirmama | avasthā śapathaścaiva sarvamāryeṇa cintyatām || 15 || rāmaḥ --- hanūman! alamalaṃ sambhrameṇa| etadanuṣṭhīyate| (śaraṃ muktvā) hanta patito bālī| lakṣmaṇaḥ --- eṣa eṣa bālī, rudhirakalitagātraḥ strastasaṃraktanetraḥ kaṭhinavipulabāhuḥ kālalokaṃ vivakṣuḥ | abhipatati kathañcid dhīramākarṣamāṇaḥ śaravaraparivītaṃ śāntavegaṃ śarīram || 16 || bālī --- (mohamupagamya punaḥ samāśvasya śare nāmākṣarāṇi vācayitvā rāmamuddiśya) yuktaṃ bho! narapatidharmamāsthitena yuddhe māṃ chalayitumakrameṇa rāma !| vīreṇa vyapagatadharmasaṃśayena lokānāṃ chalamapanetumudyatena || 17 || hantaḥ bhoḥ| bhavatā saumyarūpeṇa yaśaso bhājanena ca | chalena māṃ praharatā prarūḍhamayaśaḥ kṛtam || 18 || bho rāghava| cīravalkaladhāriṇā veṣaviparyastacittena mama bhrātrā saha yuddhavyagrasyādhamryaḥ khalu pracchanno vadhaḥ| rāmaḥ --- kathamadhamryaḥ khalu pracchanno vadha iti| bālī --- kaḥ saṃśayaḥ | rāmaḥ --- na khalvetat| paśya, vāgurācchannamāśritya mṛgāṇāmiṣyate vadhaḥ | vadhyatvācca mṛgatvācca bhavāñchannena daṇḍitaḥ || 19 || bālī --- daṇḍya iti māṃ bhavān manyate| rāmaḥ --- kaḥ saṃśayaḥ| bālī --- kena kāraṇena| rāmaḥ --- agamyāgamanena| bālī --- agamyāgamaneneti| eṣo'smākaṃ dharmaḥ| rāmaḥ --- nanu yuktaṃ bhoḥ! bhavatā vānarendreṇa dharmādharmau vijānatā | ātmānaṃ mṛgamuddiśya bhrātṛdārābhimarśanam || 20 || bālī --- bhrātṛdārābhimarśanena tulyadoṣayorahameva daṇḍito, na sugrīvaḥ| rāmaḥ --- daṇḍitastvaṃ hi daṇḍyatvād, adaṇḍyo naiva daṇḍyate| bālī --- sugrīveṇābhimṛṣṭābhūd dharmapatnī gurormama | tasya dārābhimarśena kathaṃ daṇḍyo'smi rāghava || 21 || rāmaḥ --- na tvevaṃ hi kadācijjyeṣṭhasya yavīyaso dārābhimarśanam| bālī --- hanta anuttarā vayam| bhavatā daṇḍitatvād vigatapāpo'haṃ nanu| rāmaḥ --- evamastu| sugrīvaḥ --- hā dhik| karikarasadṛśau gajendragāmiṃstava ripuśastraparikṣatāṅgadau ca | avanitalagatau samīkṣya bāhū harivara! hā patatīva me'dya cittam || 22 || bālī --- sugrīva! alamalaṃ viṣādena| īdṛśo lokadharmaḥ| (nepathye) hā hā mahārāo| bālī --- sugrīva! saṃvāryatāṃ saṃvāryatāṃ strījanaḥ| evaṃgataṃ nārhati māṃ draṣṭum| sugrīvaḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ | hanūman! evaṃ kriyatām| hanūmān --- yadājñāpayati kumāraḥ| (niṣkrāntaḥ|) (tataḥ praviśatyaṅgado hanūmāṃśca) hanūmān --- aṅgada! ita itaḥ| aṅgadaḥ --- śrutvā kālavaśaṃ yāntaṃ harimṛkṣagaṇeśvaram | samāpatitasantāpaḥ prayāmi śithilakramaḥ || 23 || hanūman! kutra mahārājaḥ| hanūmān --- eṣa mahārājaḥ, śaranirbhinnahṛdayo vibhāti dharaṇītale | guhaśaktisamākrānto yathā krauñcācalottamaḥ || 24 || aṅgadaḥ --- (upasṛtya) hā mahārāja! atibalasukhaśāyī pūrvamāsīddharīndraḥ kṣititalaparivartī kṣīṇasarvāṅgaceṣṭaḥ | śaravaraparivītaṃ vyaktamutsṛjya dehaṃ kimabhilaṣasi vīra svargamadyābhigantum || 25 || (iti bhūmau patitaḥ) bālī --- aṅgada! alamalaṃ viṣādena| bhoḥ sugrīva! mayā kṛtaṃ doṣamapāsya buddhyā tvayā harīṇāmadhipena samyak | vimucya roṣaṃ parigṛhya dharmaṃ kulapravālaṃ parigṛhyatāṃ naḥ || 23 || sugrīvaḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ | bālī --- bho rāghava! yasmin vāparādhe'nayorvānaracāpalaṃ kṣantumarhasi| rāmaḥ --- bāḍham| bālī --- sugrīva! pratigṛhyatāmasmatkuladhanaṃ hemamālā| rāmaḥ --- anugṛhīto'smi| (pratigṛhṇāti|) bālī --- hanūman! āpastāvat| hanūmān --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| (niṣkramya praviśya) imā āpaḥ bālī --- (ācamya) parityajantīva māṃ prāṇāḥ| imā gaṅgāprabhṛtayo mahānadya etā urvaśyādayo'psaraso māmabhigatāḥ| eṣa sahastrahaṃsaprayukto vīravāhī vimānaḥ kālena preṣito māṃ netumāgataḥ| bhavatu| ayamayamāgacchami| (svaryātaḥ|) sarve --- hā hā mahārāja!| rāmaḥ --- hanta svargaṃ gato vālī| sugrīva! kriyatāmasya saṃskāraḥ| sugrīvaḥ --- yadājñāpayati devaḥ| rāmaḥ --- lakṣmaṇa! sugrīvasyābhiṣekaḥ kalpyatām| lakṣmaṇaḥ --- yadājñāpayatyāryaḥ| (niṣkrāntāḥ sarve) prathamo'ṅkaḥ samāptaḥ| <2> (tataḥ praviśati kakubhaḥ|) kakubhaḥ --- niṣṭhitaprāyatvāt kāryasyāhāravyāpṛtāḥ sarve vānarayūthapāḥ| tasmādahamapi kiñcidāhārajātaṃ sambhāvayāmi| (tathā karoti|) (praviśya) bilamukhaḥ --- pesio mhi mahālāeṇa suggīveṇa ayyarāmassa kidovaārappaccuvaāraṇimittaṃ savvāsu disāsu sīdāviaaṇe pesiā savve vāṇarā āadā| tesaṃ dakkhiṇāpahamuhassa kumārassa aṅgadassa pavutiṃta jāṇia sigghaṃ āacchatti| tā kahiṃ ṇu hu gao kumāro| (parikramyāgrato vilokya) eso ayyakauho| jāva ṇaṃ pucchāmi| (upasṛtya) suhaṃ ayyassa| (preṣito'smi mahārājena sugrīveṇa āryarāmasya kṛtopakārapratyupakāranimittaṃ sarvāsu diśāsu sītāvicayane preṣitāḥ sarve vānarā āgatāḥ| teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāpathamukhasya kumārasyāṅgadasya pravṛtiṃta jñātvā śīghramāgaccheti| tat kva nu khalu gataḥ kumāraḥ| eṣa āryakakubhaḥ| yāvadenaṃ pṛcchāmi| sukhamāryasya) kakubhaḥ --- aye bilamukhaḥ| kuto bhavān| bilamukhaḥ --- ayya! mahālāassa sāsaṇeṇa kumāraṃ aṅgadaṃ pekkhiduṃ āadomhi| (ārya! mahārājasya śāsanena kumāramaṅgadaṃ prekṣitumāgato'smi|) kakubhaḥ --- api kuśalī āryarāmo mahārājaśca bilamukhaḥ --- ām| kakubhaḥ --- ko'bhiprāyo mahārājasya| (bilamukhaḥ pesio mhi iti pūrvavat paṭhati) kakubhaḥ --- kiṃ na jānīṣe niṣṭhitamardhaṃ kāryasya| bilamukhaḥ --- kiṃ kim| kakubhaḥ --- śrūyatāṃ, labdhvā vṛttāntaṃ rāmapatnyāḥ khagendrād āruhyāgendraṃ sadvipendraṃ mahendram | laṅkāmabhyetuṃ vāyuputreṇa śīghraṃ vīryaprābalyāllaṅdhitaḥ sāgaro'dya || 1 || tasmādāgaccha, kumārapādamūlameva saṃśrayāvaḥ| (niṣkrāntau|) viṣkambhakaḥ| (tataḥ praviśati rākṣasīgaṇaparivṛtā sītā|) sītā --- haddhi adidhīrā khu mhi mandabhāā| jā ayyauttavirahidā rakkhasarāabhavaṇaṃ āṇīdā aṇiṭṭhāṇi aṇarihāṇi jahamaṇorahappavuttāṇi vaaṇāṇi sāviamāṇā jīvāmi mandabhāā| ādu ayyauttasāaappaccaeṇa kahaṃ vi attāṇaṃ payyavatthāvemi| kiṃ ṇu khu ajja pajjāliamāṇe kambhaāraggimaṇḍale udaappaseo vi a kiñci hiaadhasādo samuṇṇṇo| kiṃ ṇu maṃ antareṇa pasaṇṇahiao ayyautto bhave| (hā dhig atidhīrā khalvasmi mandabhāgā| āryaputravirahitā rākṣasarājabhavanamānītāniṣṭānyanarhāṇi yathāmanorathapravṛttāni śrāvyamāṇā jīvāmi mandabhāgā| athavā āryaputrasāyakapratyayena kathamapyātmānaṃ paryavasthāpayāmi| kinnu khalvadya prajvālyamāne karmakārāgnimaṇḍale udakapraseka iva kiñcid hṛdayaprasādaḥ samutpannaḥ| kinnu khalu māmantareṇa prasannahṛdaya āryaputro bhavet|) hanūmān --- (laṅkāṃ praviśya) aho rāvaṇabhavanasya vinyāsaḥ| kanakaracitacitratoraṇāḍhyā maṇivaravidrumaśobhitapradeśā | vimalavikṛtasañcitairvimānairviyati mahendrapurīva bhāti laṅkā || 2 || aho nu khalu, etāṃ prāpya daśagrīvo rājalakṣmīmanuttamām | vimārgapratipannatvād vyāpādayitumudyataḥ || 3 || (sarvato gatvā) vicaritaprāyā mayā laṅkā| garbhagāraviniṣkuṭeṣu bahuśaḥ śālāvimānādiṣu snānāgāraniśācarendrabhavanaprāsādahamryeṣu ca | pānāgāraniśāntadeśavivareṣvākrāntavānasmyahaṃ sarvaṃ bho! vicitaṃ na caiva nṛpateḥ patnī mayā dṛśyate || 4 || aho vyartho me pariśramaḥ| bhavatu etaddhamryāgramāruhyāvalokayāmi| (tathā kṛtvā) aye ayaṃ pramadavanarāśiḥ| imaṃ praviśya parīkṣiṣye| (praviśyāvalokya) aho pramadavanasamṛddhiḥ| iha hi, kanakaracitavidrumendranīlairvikṛtamahādrumapaḍkticitradeśā | rucirataranagā vibhāti śubhrā nabhasi surendravihārabhūmikalpā || 5 || api ca, citraprasrutahemadhāturucirāḥ śailāśca dṛṣṭā mayā nānāvāricarāṇḍajairviracitā dṛṣṭā mayā dīrdhikāḥ | nityaṃ puṣpaphalāḍhyapādapayutā deśāśca dṛṣṭā mayā sarvaṃ dṛṣṭamidaṃ hi rāvaṇagṛhe sītā na dṛṣṭā mayā || 6 || ko nu khalvetasmin pradeśe saprabha iva dṛśyate| tatra tāvadavalokayāmi | (tathā kṛtvā) aye kā nanu khalilvayam | rākṣasībhiḥ parivṛtā vikṛtābhiḥ sumadhyamā | nīlajīmūtamadhyasthā vidyullekheva śobhate || 7 || yaiṣā, asitabhujagakalpāṃ dhārayantyekaveṇīṃ karaparimitamadhyā kāntasaṃsaktacittā | anaśanakṛśadehā bāṣpasaṃsiktavaktrā sarasijavanamālevātape vipraviddhā || 8 || aye kathaṃ dīpikāvalokaḥ| (vilokya) aye rāvaṇaḥ| maṇi viracitamauliścārutāmrāyatākṣo madasalalitagāmī mattamātaṅgalīlaḥ | yuvatijananikāye bhātyasau rākṣaseśo haririva hariṇīnāmantare ceṣṭamānaḥ||9|| kimidānīṃ kariṣye| bhavatu, dṛṣṭam, enamaśokapādapamāruhya koṭarāntarito bhūtvā dṛḍhaṃ vṛttāntaṃ jñāsyāmi| (tathā karoti|) (tataḥ praviśati rāvaṇaḥsaparivāraḥ|) rāvaṇaḥ --- divyāstraiḥ suradaityadānavacamūvidrāvaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ yuddhe kruddhasure bhadantakuliśavyālīḍhavakṣasthalam | sītā māmavivekinī na ramate saktā ca mugdhekṣaṇā kṣudre kṣatriyatāpase dhruvamaho daivasya vighnakriyā || 10 || (ūdhrvamavalokya) eṣa eṣa candramāḥ, rajataracitadarpaṇaprakāśaḥ karanikarairhṛdayaṃ mamābhipīṅya | udayati gagane vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ kumudavanapriyabāndhavaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ || 11 || (parikramya) eṣā sītā pādapamūlamāśritya dhyānasaṃvītahṛdayānaśanakṣāmavadanā svadehamiva praveṣṭukāmā saṅgūḍhastanodarī durdināntargatā candralekheva rākṣasīgaṇaparivṛtopaviṣṭā| yaiṣā, apāsya bhogān māṃ caiva śriyaṃ ca mahatīmimām | mānuṣe nyastahṛdyā naiva vaśyatvamāgatā || 12 || hanūmān --- hanta suvijñātam| iyaṃ sā rājatanayā patnī rāmasya maithilī | siṃhadarśanavitrastā mṛgīva paritapyate || 13 || rāvaṇaḥ --- (upetya) sīte! tyaja
